about: CQS Orbital Fleet parts kit: small hull components, each designed once with fal (nano-banana-pro, then /edit with the door concept as the style reference), reconstructed on its own with Tripo H3.1 image-to-3D and normalised to true metres, so every ship composed from them shares the same door, window and rail sizes.
frame: Metres. +Z = out of the hull (surface normal), +Y = up along the part height, +X = along the width. Parts with mount.normal "+Z" have their back (mounting) face at z = 0, centred on x/y (ladder: foot at y = 0). Parts with mount.normal "+Y" (rail, antenna, container) stand on their foot/base at y = 0, centred on x/z: orient their +Y along the hull normal.
paint: Light off-white weathered paint with dark blue-grey glass, as generated; the runtime livery (src/lib/livery.js applyLivery) repaints it dark matte grey and turns the glass texels into glossy glass.
pipeline: tripo GLB -> flatten, rotate (normaliseRot, degrees, R = Rz*Ry*Rx), scale to size (per-axis where the table fixes all three dims), anchor -> dedup, prune, weld -> WebP textures (512 or 1024) -> meshopt (tools: scratchpad v7/parts/normalize.mjs, same steps as tools/optimize-glb.mjs).
sizeSource: Target sizes from the v7 parts brief; size[] is the final bbox [w, h, d].

cost.meshUsdEachNote: Tripo H3.1 price as recorded in the README (fal bills Tripo in credits)

door.notes: Crew door: 1.0 x 2.0 m hinged leaf (hinges on the -X side, grab handle and lever on +X, small viewport at eye height) recessed in a 1.4 x 2.4 x 0.3 m chamfered frame. Frame back at z = 0, front face at z = 0.3; to sit ~0.1 m proud as specified, sink it 0.2 m into the hull (position.z = -0.2 along the normal). The reconstruction mirrored the door onto the back face (hidden when mounted). Depth squashed ~0.45x relative to width to reach 0.3 m.

airlock.notes: Crew airlock: flat 1.8 x 2.6 m back flange at z = 0, protruding pressure collar with locking lugs, hatch with a round viewport and a handwheel; collar face at z = 0.8.

port.notes: Single 1.0 x 1.0 m round-cornered window aperture in a thick 1.3 x 1.3 x 0.3 m chamfered, bolted frame (frame is crisp). Back at z = 0; sink 0.2 m into the hull for the ~0.1 m proud look. KNOWN ISSUE: both reconstructions (transparent and opaque-glass concepts) left the glazing out, so the aperture is open through the part; mounted flush, the hull behind it shows through. Back it with a dark glass material at composition time or regenerate the port (e.g. H3.1 multiview) in a later round.

pane.notes: Bridge glazing module 1.2 x 1.4 x 0.3 m (1.0 x 1.2 m glass), square outer sides: tile at a 1.2 m pitch along X. Back at z = 0. Frame edges are soft/pillowy (reconstruction rounded the square mullions); reads fine at bridge-band distance but is the least crisp part.

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

cargoHatch.notes: Framed 6 x 4 m double-leaf cargo hatch (hinge blocks along the top, locking bolts on the centre seam), 0.4 m deep, back at z = 0.

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

rail.notes: Handrail segment, 1.0 m long (X) x 1.1 m high (Y): two posts on bolted foot plates, top rail and mid rail. Mounts by its feet: origin at the centre of the foot line, feet at y = 0, the deck normal is +Y (place with +Y along the hull normal and X along the run). Tile end to end at a 1.0 m pitch (bbox includes the top-rail overhangs; posts at about x = +-0.33). Tubes read ~80-90 mm, thicker than the 50 mm spec. Reconstruction was skewed 17.5 deg in plan and was straightened.

mount.origin: bottom centre of the back face

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

ladder.notes: Wall rung ladder 0.5 m wide x 3.0 m tall, 11 rungs (~0.28 m pitch), standoff brackets at top and bottom. Origin at the bottom centre of the back (bracket) face: foot at y = 0, back at z = 0, +Z out of the hull. The concept was drawn ~1:3.3, so Y is stretched ~3x relative to X; rungs read slightly oval.

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

rcs.notes: RCS quad: 1.0 x 1.0 m back plate at z = 0, chamfered block, four nozzles pointing +Y, -Y, +X, -X (nozzle exits roughly 0.35 m out from the part centre along each axis, at z ~0.3).

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

antenna.notes: Mast 6.0 m tall (Y) on a 0.3 m square base box, three dipole pairs (0.43 m span) and a tip. Mounts by its base: origin at the base centre, base at y = 0, the hull normal is +Y. X/Z were scaled 0.375x relative to Y so the base is 0.3 m.

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

dome.notes: Sensor radome ~2.46 m diameter (near-spherical, with a seam band) on a short bolted octagonal ring; flange 2.5 m at z = 0, top at z = 2.36. Axis is +Z (hull normal).

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

floodlight.notes: Floodlight: 0.6 m lamp housing on a U yoke, base plate at z = 0 on the hull, lamp centre ~0.4 m out. The lens aims +Y (along the hull); rotate about Z to aim it. Lens texel is blue-grey glass (livery glass); add a SpotLight at the lens centre if it should throw light.

fal.params: texture, pbr, texture_quality detailed, geometry_quality detailed

container.notes: 20-ft ISO container 6.06 (X) x 2.59 (Y) x 2.44 (Z) m, doors at +X, bottom at y = 0 (deck normal +Y), origin at the bottom centre. Corrugated side walls reconstructed soft/wavy: reads as a container at hangar distances, not crisp up close.
